bias.en: Bearish, improving · SAR turned bullish, above the 10 and 200-day
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · SAR 转多，站上 10 日和 200 日均线

read.en: Bloom Energy rose 4.4% on Oct 28 to $228.08, trading between $217.90 and $231.67. It is above the falling 5-day ($212.3) and 10-day ($220.7) averages and the rising 200-day ($220.6), and below the falling 30-day ($257.4) and 100-day ($246.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 28 ($189.00), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月28日上涨 4.4%，收于 $228.08，盘中区间 $217.90–231.67。股价位于下行的 5 日（$212.3）和 10 日均线（$220.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$220.6）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$257.4）和 100 日均线（$246.4）。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 10月28日转为看多（$189.00），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The close cleared $220.6–224.2 (10 and 200-day, Oct 27 high), now support, and turned the SAR bullish; the high stopped under $233.6. Resistance is $231.7–233.6 (Oct 28, 16 and 19 highs), then $241.4 (Oct 21 high) and $246.4 (100-day). Support is $220.6–224.2, then $211.3–212.3 (Oct 27 low, 5-day) and $197.5 (Sep 1 low). A close above $233.6 would target $241–246; below $220.6, $212.

r.en: Oct 28 high $231.7; Oct 16 and Oct 19 highs ($233.5–233.6)
